features.text: Technical reply within one business day

aboutTeaser.heading: 20+ years delivering certified rigging in Vietnam
aboutTeaser.body: United Mekong JSC is the authorised distributor of Green Pin, ABLE and other leading rigging brands in Vietnam. Every assembly we produce is proof-tested on our 700-tonne horizontal test bed and delivered with traceable certificates.

highlights.desc: Green Pin bow & dee shackles, screw-pin and safety-bolt
ABLE webbing & round slings, colour-coded to EN 1492
Chain blocks, lever hoists, trolleys & winches

servicesTeaser.heading: End-to-end rigging services
servicesTeaser.subhead: From spooling to proof testing to NDT inspection — everything under one roof in Vung Tau.

services.title: Wire Rope Spooling
services.desc: Precision spooling from drum to drum with tension control. Available in our Vung Tau facility.

services.title: Load & Proof Testing
services.desc: In-house 700-tonne horizontal test bed. Full proof-load certificates issued for every tested assembly.

services.title: Inspection & NDT
services.desc: Visual inspection, MPI, MT & PT by Level II certified technicians. Compliant with EN13414 and DNV standards.
